# NPM Improved v1.7.5

## NPMX peer version synchronization

- Fix stale primary-side peer version reporting after a secondary upgrades: the secondary now announces its running version and NPMX protocol through an authenticated heartbeat **before** snapshot version negotiation, rather than only after a successful snapshot.
- Keep strict compatibility and authentication enforcement. Nodes running genuinely different versions still cannot synchronize, acknowledge ACME gates, or issue cluster-coordinated HTTP-01 certificates.
- ACME mismatch errors now include the peer's reported version, protocol and last heartbeat timestamp to distinguish an outdated secondary from stale metadata or interrupted synchronization.

## Deployment

Update the **secondary** (`76.250.238.65`) and **primary** (`76.250.238.67`) to the same version. A secondary still on an old release cannot participate in the new v1.7.4 coordinated ACME protocol. Verify both versions and that the secondary has successfully checked in before retrying certificate issuance.

No pairing resets, database migrations, or certificate deletion are required.
